sentences.en: There must be a chink in the armour somewhere.
sentences.zh: armor 的某个地方肯定有破绽。

sentences.en: A single ray of sunlight shone through a chink in the shuttered window.
sentences.zh: 透过关上的窗户的一道缝隙，射进了一缕阳光。

sentences.en: Aart called the Chinese guy Chink.
sentences.zh: Aart 把那个中国人叫做‘叮当’。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：chin（看作china，瓷器）+ k（口）→瓷器有缺口→裂口
